script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for December 16. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Words repeated become beliefs.  Beliefs shape actions.  Actions create outcomes.

Effective affirmations stretch but don't snap. 'I'm the best ever' feels false. 'I'm improving every day' feels possible. Choose affirmations you can believe while moving toward what you want. Affirmations work through repetition.  One statement once changes nothing.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: What you repeat becomes what you believe.  Choose your repeated words carefully.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Affirmation Creation - What Will You Repeat?.

Here's your activity: Create three affirmations: statements about who you want to be or what you want to believe. Make them believable but stretching. Practice saying them daily for a week. Notice if your thinking shifts. This helps you create and practice personal affirmations.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about words that shape beliefs can be applied to affirmation creation - what will you repeat?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
